name: Ura Kazoku Yuugi ~Oyako Choukyou Hanashi~
original_name: 裏家族遊戯～母娘調教譚～
source:
Father remarries a very young girl, and protagonist moves out to live alone. But as father gets into an accident, step mother begs protagonist to return home. The scale of distortion at home is yet to become known.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
